subject: Checkout success-rate drop — evidence & entitlement triage
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex@parcelcloud.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: ParcelCloud Support <support@parcelcloud.com>
Date: 2026-08-27T23:12:00Z
Subject: Checkout failures observed — need downtime confirmation & credits

Hi Connor,

We saw a sharp drop in checkout success rate on ParcelCloud between ~02:15 and 02:40 UTC today (Aug 27). Our telemetry shows ~14% failed checkout attempts (timeouts / 503s) for requests routed through Redwood's inference endpoint /v1/generate during that window — this impacted our payment verification flow and led to a spike in abandoned carts.

Can you confirm whether Redwood had a service interruption in that interval and whether this is eligible for an SLA credit? We need:
- confirmation of any service/unavailability windows affecting our tenant
- list of request_ids (if available) or guidance for correlating traces
- expected timeline for evidence pull and credit calculation

I can attach our client-side request logs if that helps. Attaching a short sample (parcelcloud_client_logs_0827.zip).

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Platform — ParcelCloud
alex@parcelcloud.com

[attachment: parcelcloud_client_logs_0827.zip (application/zip) — contains sample request IDs and timestamps]

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-27T23:36:00Z
Subject: Re: Checkout failures observed — need downtime confirmation & credits

Alex — thanks for the heads up and for the logs. We're looking into this now.

Action plan / what I need from you:
- can you confirm all timestamps are in UTC? (looks like they are from the sample)
- send 2–3 representative request_ids (included in the ZIP) that failed during the 02:15–02:40 UTC window — those will let us cross-reference Redwood traces quickly

I'm looping in Diego (SRE) and Laura (Customer Success) to coordinate the evidence pull and to outline the credit eligibility process. We typically:
1) validate an availability window from our telemetry
2) correlate tenant request_ids to our logs/traces
3) determine SLA eligibility and compute a prorated credit per the contract

We aim to turn around an initial eligibility confirmation within 3 business days once we have the trace IDs and your logs. If eligible, full calculation and remedy proposal usually follow within 7 business days.

Diego — can you take a look at infra telemetry for US regions (us-west/primary) and confirm any anomalies during the affected window?

Connor
Senior Account Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com

Thanks — I ran a quick sweep against infra metrics and traces for the 02:00–03:00 UTC window:
- We observed an autoscaler eviction event in the us-west inference pool at ~02:18 UTC that caused elevated request queueing and a small number of 503 responses between 02:18:12 and 02:38:50 UTC.
- Root cause looks like a transient combination of an increased tail-latency under burst + one noisy shard eviction triggered by a VM preemption.
- Preliminary impacted window (redwood telemetry): 2026-08-27T02:18:12Z — 2026-08-27T02:38:50Z (approx).

I attached a short trace summary and a tarball with sampled server-side spans: service_trace_summary-0827.tar.gz. This is an initial packet; I'll pull a fuller raw trace bundle if Alex confirms the request_ids they want correlated.

Linking internal incident: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4392

Laura — can you prepare the SLA/credits playbook for ParcelCloud (contract PC-2025-Q3-09) so we can align expectations?

Diego
SRE — Redwood Inference

Appreciate the quick coordination — happy to jump on a short call if that helps.

—Alex

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-28T11:34:00Z
Subject: Re: Checkout success-rate drop — evidence & entitlement triage

Alex — thanks for the request IDs and the expanded bundle; Diego and I correlated the three sample request_ids to server traces in INC-4392 and can confirm they fall inside the eviction window (02:18:12–02:38:50Z).

Summary / next steps:
- Confirmation: Redwood telemetry shows a service impact affecting ParcelCloud traffic in that interval (confirmation only; formal eligibility calculation pending full evidence pull).
- Evidence pull: we'll produce a consolidated evidence package that includes the raw server traces, request-level correlation table for tenant request_ids, and a short RC summary. Expect initial package within 3 business days; full calculation within 7 business days.
- Eligibility: SLA eligibility follows contract PC-2025-Q3-09 — brief callout: short transient events under our exception policy for noisy shard preemption can be considered for pro-rata credits if they resulted in measurable availability < 99.9% for the billing period. We'll compute the prorated credit and provide the calculation in our remedy proposal.

Administrative items:
- If ParcelCloud would like Redwood to escrow the evidence and a provisional credit hold while we finish the calculation, please confirm and we'll start the process (requires a signed acceptance of the evidence transfer doc; I can send that as a DocuSign).
- Laura will follow up with a formal timeline and a draft credit calculation once Diego completes the raw trace export.

If you approve escrow and evidence pull, reply with a one-line confirmation and we'll start the export immediately. If you'd prefer a brief sync instead, Laura / I can set up a 30-min slot today or tomorrow.

Connor O'Brien
